evals.prompt: i have a hiring manager call at Northwind Labs on Thursday 10:00 with Jane Okafor, she is the VP Engineering. help me prepare. no web access in this session. put documents in ./docs
evals.expected_output: Builds the pack with stage hiring manager, reads it, does not invent facts about Jane Okafor, answers only from the master CV, flags the Terraform gap honestly, saves a prep sheet.
assertions: Ran `job-radar interview ... --stage "hiring manager"` and read the file
Jane Okafor details are marked not found / UNVERIFIED, not invented
Example answers use only facts in master-cv.md (six engineers, hired four, backlog 63 to one to three, Kubernetes, zero-day IC) and no invented numbers
Flags Terraform (in the posting, not in the CV) as a gap and gives an honest bridge, not a claim of Terraform experience
Saved a prep sheet file and gave its absolute path
Said that company/interviewer research could not be done without web access

evals.prompt: i have a recruiter screen at Northwind Labs tomorrow, can you get me ready? no web access in this session. put documents in ./docs
evals.expected_output: The application has no CV recorded. The agent must say so and ask which file was sent rather than assuming one.
assertions: Response says the pack records no CV for this application
Asks which CV file was actually sent instead of assuming the master or newest CV
Contains no claim about experience that is not in master-cv.md

evals.prompt: can we do a mock interview for the Northwind Labs hiring manager round? i want to practise answering. no web access
evals.expected_output: A mock interview asks one question at a time and waits for the answer.
assertions: Asks exactly one interview question and then stops to wait for the user's answer
The question is relevant to a hiring manager round for an Engineering Manager, Platform role
Does not write the candidate's answer for them in the same turn
